# Research and naming notes

All reticles are newly encoded as integer vector commands. No game texture, manufacturer artwork, screenshot, or raster reticle is embedded. Historical, commercial, and game names describe the design reference used during research. Unless a preset is explicitly intended as a generic pattern, treat it as a visual interpretation rather than a ballistic/calibration-grade replica.

## Main research families

- **PSG1:** Hensoldt ZF 6×42 / illuminated-reticle references and the Resident Evil 5 presentation.
- **Mosin M1891/30:** PE, PEM and PU families, plus the custom Revelations 2 scope whose reticle is described as PU-like.
- **Resident Evil:** S75, PSG1, SVD, M1891/30, Muramasa/AMR, SA110, RE4 and RE6 visual variants.
- **First and Second World Wars:** PPCo, Aldis, Winchester A5, Warner & Swasey, No.32, ZF families, Japanese Type 97/99 and US M73B1/M81/M82/M84 patterns.
- **Cold War / Eastern optics:** PSO-1 variants, ZRAK, LPS TIP2, 1P21/1P59, night optics, SUSAT and Trilux-derived layouts.
- **Modern precision:** MIL/MOA hashes, BDC ladders, open-center reticles, Christmas-tree grids, wind dots, hunting and digital overlays.
